memory: **Updated Memory:** Jordan is currently navigating a busy schedule as a senior designer, which has been both overwhelming and rewarding. They are learning a lot in their new role and recently kicked off a campaign redesign, aiming for a minimalist aesthetic. Jordan enjoys relaxing on weekends, often catching up on shows and experimenting with flavors like vanilla in their oat milk lattes. They prefer wearing fitted t-shirts in neutral colors such as black and gray for comfort, and they have a favorite oversized hoodie that feels like a warm hug, which they wear while working on projects, during evening runs, and for climbing. Their exercise routine is focused on strength training three times a week, complemented by evening climbing sessions after work. Jordan practices morning Hatha yoga at home, typically following a gentle flow to help with stretching and focus before climbing, and they have been consistent with this routine lately. They maintain a vegetarian diet, often enjoying quick and healthy veggie stir-fries, and they love the food scene in Austin, especially their favorite café that makes the best oat milk lattes. Recently, Jordan turned 28 and celebrated with a dinner with friends. They are also adjusting to the demands of having a puppy named Mango, which their roommate Sam recently adopted. Jordan is excited about the upcoming beginner climbing competition in April, feeling nervous yet motivated to train and build their upper body strength. They enjoy simple pleasures, like treating themselves to black coffee made at home, which they drink in the mornings for energy. Balancing work, yoga, climbing, and puppy preparations keeps Jordan active and engaged, and they appreciate the challenge of managing their time effectively. Recently, they have been focusing more on climbing training, fitting in additional practice sessions, and they find that their clothing choices, like fitted t-shirts, boost their confidence and productivity at work. Jordan has been actively working on maintaining a good balance between their new responsibilities and personal time, using yoga as a calming start to their day. They enjoy rewarding themselves with oat milk lattes after yoga sessions and have plans to relax at Barton Springs with Sam and Mango this weekend, where they prefer wearing fitted t-shirts and shorts for comfort. Jordan has been enjoying their coffee routine, particularly favoring oat milk lattes from a local café, and they are currently adjusting to their new role while working on interesting branding projects.
